description: Swiss residence permits L, B, C, Ci, G, F, N, S (incl. the asylum statuses): what each permit is, the official rules (validity, renewal, C permit after 10 or 5 years, language levels, EU/EFTA 5-year list, moving within Switzerland) each with its law article (AIG, VZAE, BüG) or SEM page, and the number of people per permit (BFS, 2010 to latest year) for Switzerland or a canton. Information, not legal advice: the cantonal migration office decides.
name: permit_types
